one_liner.zh: 本周加密与美股期货同向 risk-off：BTC 窗口约 -4.4%、偏震荡，杠杆中性，实现波动中等而期权相对 RV 偏贵；美现货 BTC ETF 通道温和流出（净 -4.63 亿美金），现货成交额同步略降温。
one_liner.en: Crypto and US equity futures moved in risk-off sync: BTC window ~-4.4% in chop, leverage neutral, mid realized vol with options rich vs RV; US spot BTC ETF channel mild outflow (net -462.70M) alongside softer spot turnover.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -4.63 亿美金

risk.zh: IV-RV 溢价仍厚、清算峰值落在周中，若 risk-off 延续而资金通道未稳，震荡中枢可能下移。
risk.en: Thick IV-RV premium and mid-week liquidation peak leave room for the chop range to drift lower if risk-off persists without steadier spot channels.

watch.zh: 盯 ETF 净流是否止住温和流出、IV 溢价是否收敛，以及永续活跃度是否继续环比回落。
watch.en: Watch whether ETF net flow stops the mild outflow, whether the IV premium compresses, and whether perp activity keeps cooling week-on-week.

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: BTC 窗口收益约 -4.36%，ETH 约 -1.49%，二者都弱于上一段的正收益周；相对美股，ES 约 -0.81%、NQ 约 -0.60%，VIX 跳升约 +9.0%，黄金约 -1.44%，美元指数几乎持平，整体呈现「加密更深、但方向一致」的 risk-off 画面，而非加密独自脱钩。
compare.en: BTC window return ~-4.36% and ETH ~-1.49% both reversed from the prior positive week; vs US futures, ES ~-0.81%, NQ ~-0.60%, VIX up ~+9.0%, gold ~-1.44%, DXY flat—crypto weaker in magnitude but aligned in risk-off direction rather than decoupling alone.

path.zh: 路径标签为偏震荡：周内未见单边趋势延伸，更多是在 risk-off 背景下的区间摩擦；清算次数峰值出现在 9 月 11 日（1241 笔），与价格下压日重叠，但未演化成持续踩踏叙事。
path.en: Path labeled chop/low-trend: no sustained one-way extension, more range friction under risk-off; liquidation count peaked on 11 Sep (1241) coinciding with price pressure, without turning into a cascading narrative.

leverage.zh: 杠杆中性：期末 funding 约 +7.84%/yr 年化、OI 周变动约 -0.61%，未见拥挤多头或空头极端；永续成交额周合计约 652.65 亿美金、环比约 -14.5%，活跃度标签正常偏降温，杠杆层更像在减噪而非加码方向。
leverage.en: Leverage neutral: end funding ~+7.84%/yr annualized, OI change ~-0.61%, no extreme crowded long/short; perp turnover sum ~65.26B USD, WoW ~-14.5%, activity normal-to-cooler—leverage layer de-noising rather than amplifying a directional bet.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎约 -4.63 亿美金，通道标签温和流出（0 个净流入日、4 个净流出日，单日最深约 -2.83 亿在 9 月 10 日）；ETH ETF 净约 +1.97 亿美金。并陈 Binance 口径现货成交额周合计约 73.41 亿美金、环比约 -6.6%，总量热闹度略降，不与 ETF 净流加总、也不拆多空。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETF aggregate net ~-462.70M USD, channel mild outflow (0 inflow days, 4 outflow days; deepest day ~-282.7M on 10 Sep); ETH ETF net ~+196.90M. Alongside, spot exchange turnover sum ~7.34B USD, WoW ~-6.6%—overall heat a touch softer; do not sum with ETF net or split long/short.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 73.41 亿美金，相对上完整周 -6.6%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 78.60 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-09-11（15.29 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 652.65 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 7.34B, vs prior full week -6.6% (activity “normal”; prior ~7.86B). Peak day 2026-09-11 (1.53B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (65.26B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 中等 RV 配上明显 IV 溢价，意味着市场仍在为尾部与跳空付费，即使现货路径只是震荡下压；溢价可以来自对后续宏观/流动性不确定性的保险需求，而不必然等于「马上大波动已兑现」。
vol_teach.en: Mid RV with a clear IV premium means the market is still paying for tail/gap risk even while the spot path is choppy downside; the premium can reflect insurance demand for macro/liquidity uncertainty rather than realized big moves already delivered.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 19.7%（中等），期末 Deribit IV 约 38.9%，IV-RV 点差约 +19.2 个百分点，标签为期权偏贵；ETH RV 约 31.7%、IV 约 54.3%，同样维持期权侧溢价结构。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~19.7% ann (mid), end Deribit IV ~38.9%, IV-RV spread ~+19.2 pp—options rich vs RV; ETH RV ~31.7%, IV ~54.3%, same rich-options structure.

vol_combo.zh: 波动组合画像：中等实现波动 + 期权偏贵 + 杠杆中性，属于「保险贵、仓位不极端」的一周；与同向 risk-off 的传统市场一起，更像风险偏好收缩下的定价摩擦，而非杠杆清算驱动的波动尖峰。
vol_combo.en: Vol combo: mid realized + options rich + leverage neutral—“expensive insurance, non-extreme positioning.” Together with TradFi risk-off sync, it reads as pricing friction under risk appetite pullback rather than a leverage-cascade vol spike.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格窗口约 -4.4% 的同时 IV 仍显著高于 RV，说明下跌并未把期权「砸便宜」；偏贵状态延续，使波动收割类逻辑在结构上更贴标签，而趋势跟随缺少干净斜率。
vol_price_iv.en: Price window ~-4.4% while IV stayed well above RV—the decline did not cheapen options; persistent richness keeps vol-harvest structures more label-aligned than clean trend-following slopes.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口约 +9.0%，与 BTC/美股期货同步偏弱、黄金亦软，构成跨资产的 risk-off 温度计抬升；加密 IV 溢价与 VIX 上行同向，但本周加密跌幅更深，凸性定价仍偏贵。
vol_vix.en: VIX window ~+9.0% rose with softer BTC and US equity futures (gold also soft), a cross-asset risk-off thermometer; crypto IV richness moved in the same direction as VIX, yet crypto’s deeper draw left convexity still expensive.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元略弱可作弱背景，不是主引擎。
vs_crypto.en: Mild USD softness is backdrop, not the main engine.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与 BTC 同向可兼容，但是不同资产逻辑。
vs_crypto.en: Same direction as BTC is compatible; drivers still differ.

tradfi_summary.zh: 传统括号（美股 Fri–Fri 对齐口述本报告周）：ES/NQ 小幅收负，VIX 明显抬升，美债 10Y 约 +19.1 bp，美元指数近乎零变动，黄金回撤；与加密同向 risk-off，而非股涨币跌或币涨股跌的背离周。
tradfi_summary.en: TradFi bracket (US Fri–Fri aligned to this report week): ES/NQ mildly negative, VIX clearly higher, US10Y ~+19.1 bp, DXY near flat, gold lower—risk-off in sync with crypto, not an equity-up/crypto-down or reverse divergence week.

three_conclusions.zh: 本周主叙事是跨资产同向 risk-off：BTC 约 -4.4% 与 ES/NQ 收负、VIX 上行并列，加密跌幅更深但仍共向，而非独立脱钩。
three_conclusions.en: Lead narrative is cross-asset risk-off sync: BTC ~-4.4% alongside softer ES/NQ and higher VIX—crypto deeper but co-moving, not a solo decoupling.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货通道与杠杆层同时降温：BTC ETF 温和流出约 -4.63 亿美金，现货成交额约 73.41 亿、环比约 -6.6%，永续约 652.65 亿、环比约 -14.5%，杠杆中性，资金与活跃度都未加码方向。
three_conclusions.en: Spot channel and leverage layer both cooled: BTC ETF mild outflow ~-462.70M, spot turnover ~7.34B (WoW ~-6.6%), perp ~65.26B (WoW ~-14.5%), leverage neutral—neither flow nor activity amplified a directional stance.

three_conclusions.zh: 波动结构仍是「中等 RV + 期权偏贵」：IV-RV 约 +19 pp，下跌未砸出便宜保险，故震荡与波动收割标签更贴，趋势跟随偏失配。
three_conclusions.en: Vol structure remains mid RV + rich options: IV-RV ~+19 pp, the decline did not deliver cheap insurance—so chop/vol-harvest labels fit better than trend-following.

text.zh: 下一周美现货 BTC ETF 合计净流是否仍为温和流出（或转为接近零/回流），流出日数是否继续占优。
text.en: Whether next week’s US spot BTC ETF aggregate net stays mild outflow (or flips near-zero/inflow) and whether outflow days keep dominating.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周从上周大额净流入翻成 -4.63 亿温和流出，是通道姿态切换的核心观察哨，需核对是否延续。

text.zh: BTC IV-RV 点差是否仍维持双位数溢价（期末水平附近），还是随价格震荡而收敛。
text.en: Whether BTC IV-RV spread stays in double-digit premium (near this week’s end level) or compresses as price chops.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周 RV 中等而 IV 明显偏贵，是 vol_harvest 匹配与「保险仍贵」的关键矛盾，值得下期直接对表。

text.zh: 永续成交额环比是否继续为负、funding/OI 是否仍保持中性而非重新拥挤。
text.en: Whether perp turnover WoW stays negative and funding/OI remain neutral rather than re-crowding.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周永续活跃度环比约 -14.5%、杠杆中性，若继续降温则 risk-off 更偏「减仓摩擦」而非杠杆放大。

matched.zh: 匹配 mean_reversion 与 vol_harvest：标签为偏震荡 + 杠杆中性 + 中等 RV 而 IV 相对偏贵，价格缺少单边斜率、期权侧仍付溢价，故均值回归与波动收割的结构叙事更贴本周矛盾，而非方向押注。
matched.en: Matched mean_reversion and vol_harvest: chop + leverage neutral + mid RV with rich IV means little clean directional slope while options still price a premium—mean-reversion and vol-harvest structures fit the week’s tension better than directional bets.

mismatched.zh: 不匹配 trend_following：趋势标签偏震荡、收益由正转负但路径未形成可持续单边，OI 与 funding 亦无趋势拥挤确认，跟随突破的逻辑本周缺少标签支撑。
mismatched.en: Mismatched trend_following: trend label is chop, return flipped negative without a durable one-way path, and OI/funding gave no crowded-trend confirmation—breakout-following lacked label support this week.
